title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submits resignation to Trump
summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has submitted his resignation letter to the White House, a senior U.S. official confirms. The White House has not yet accepted his resignation.

title: Trump's White House ballroom construction gets another lifeline from SCOTUS amid heated legal fight
summary: Chief Justice John Roberts warned the White House ballroom project is "likely unlawful," but the Supreme Court let construction continue for now.

title: Trump's Canada tariff fight reaches critical point as House GOP summons trade chief
summary: Jamieson Greer meets House Republicans as Trump's escalating trade war with Canada and 50% tariffs become a growing flashpoint for lawmakers.

title: Trump admin revives ‘Apprentice’-era energy with $1M business battle in DC
summary: Nicki Minaj, Grant Cardone, and Joe Gebbia will judge the SBA's Patriot Pitch as five entrepreneur finalists compete for $1 million in cash.

title: ‘Backwards and poor’: Trump issues dire warning to communities blocking critical technology
summary: President Donald Trump warned communities rejecting data centers risk becoming "backwards and poor" as states battle over AI boom energy and water costs.

title: Trump indicates support for Christian-backed plan to help Canadian Jews escape antisemitism
summary: Trump amplified a plan for expedited legal pathways for Jewish Canadians fleeing antisemitic persecution as Christian lawmakers press his administration.

title: Who pays for US power boom? Blue, red states offer starkly different ways to lower utility bills amid AI surge
summary: New Jersey is requiring big data centers to shoulder more of their own power costs, while an Indiana utility says revenue from major new customers could cut household bills by about $100 a year.

title: Rickey Jackson wins first Bassmaster Randy Moss Pro Football Hall of Fame Pro-Am on St. Lawrence River
summary: Rickey Jackson edged Joe Thomas by just 5 ounces to win the first Bassmaster Randy Moss Pro-Am on the St. Lawrence River in Clayton, New York.

title: Navy unveils ‘MALICE’ missile built to strike enemy aircraft from extreme range
summary: Raytheon is developing a new 1,500-pound long-range missile, the AIM-424 LRAAM, to extend the reach and survivability of Navy and Marine aviators.

title: Mel Gibson apologizes for mocking ASL interpreter, blames 'spontaneous thoughtless idiocy'
summary: Mel Gibson apologized after video showed him allegedly mocking an ASL interpreter at Fan Expo Canada, calling it "spontaneous thoughtless idiocy."
